programs.title: NITV News Update
programs.desc: NITV News recaptures the highlights of Indigenous news around the country.

programs.title: Wildest Places: Great Barrier Reef
programs.desc: Wildest Places: Great Barrier Reef is a four-part journey through one of Earth's most vibrant ecosystems, told through the changing seasons.

programs.title: The Point
programs.desc: With incidents of racism and negative stereotyping at record levels and First Nations protestors targeted in violent attacks the Point is on the road in Melbourne to meet those who are taking a stand.

programs.title: First Australians
programs.desc: This landmark series chronicles the birth of contemporary Australia as never told before, from the perspective of its First Peoples. The story begins in 1788 in Sydney.

programs.title: The Furnace
programs.desc: The Furnace is a tense Western set in the 1890s gold rush of Western Australia starring David Wenham , Jay Ryan, Mahesh Jadu and Baykali Ganambarr. To escape a harsh existence and return home, a young Afghan cameleer partners with a mysterious bushman on the run with two 400oz Crown-marked gold bars. Together the unlikely pair must outwit a zealous police sergeant and his troopers in a race to reach a secret furnace where they can safely reset the bars to remove the mark of the Crown.

programs.title: The Boy, The Queen
programs.desc: Max takes Gigi away for a girl’s weekend and leaves Jacob in charge. The queens turn up the drama, chaos ensues, and Jacob revisits old habits.
